capabilities: Scan tasks from all Markdown files in the vault
Edit, complete and delete tasks from the board in real time
Add tasks via modal, commands or a board button
Apply filters to boards and columns
Attach sub-tasks and descriptions to tasks
extras: README warns the Map view feature stores user data in LocalStorage (called a bad design choice) and should be avoided until version 2.0.0; full documentation lives on an external docs site rather than in the README.
intentEvidence: there are few important features this plugin is lacking and it's development has been on halt
motivation: The author used Kanban and then CardBoard, but CardBoard lacked important features and its development had been on halt; unfamiliar with its Elm codebase, they started their own plugin combining the best of Kanban, CardBoard and GitHub Projects.
problem: Managing tasks requires opening individual Markdown files, and existing boards (Kanban) tie tasks to a single board file instead of collecting vault-wide tasks in one place.

relations.evidence: I immediately switched to the CardBoard plugin after I came across it
took inspirations from CardBoard and Kanban plugin as well as many feature ideas from GitHub Project Kanban board
can scan all kinds of task formats which are supported by the Tasks plugin
With the integration of QuickAdd plugin, this feature can become a very powerful tool
Inspired by the GitHub Projects Board Layout

summary: Kanban-style task board that scans all tasks across the vault's Markdown files and lets you add, edit, complete and filter them from one centralized board.
